textos.As opiniões divergem diretamente sobre a: Opinions diverge directly on how the script is handled and on its structure. While nearly all of those who recommend it highlight the impact of the narrative clues and the twists, nearly all of those who do not recommend it consider the writing confusing and overloaded with explanations.
textos.Várias reviews criticam que o filme conf: Several reviews criticize that the film confuses in trying to be complex, with a plot that gets lost in explanations and obvious twists, making the experience drawn-out and not at all thrilling.

textos.Diversas críticas mencionam que o filme: Several reviews mention that the film is slow, with an excessive running time and scenes that drag, making the experience tiring and not very engaging.
textos.Algumas reviews afirmam que as reviravol: Some reviews state that the twists are obvious and forced, without impact, and that the narrative delivers the answers in too didactic a way, spoiling any surprise.
textos.Há críticas de que os protagonistas são: There are criticisms that the protagonists are one-dimensional, driven only by obsession, with the audience unable to care about their motivations or feelings.
textos.Várias reviews comentam que o filme se l: Several reviews comment that the film takes itself too seriously, with a pretentious approach that prioritizes explaining over showing, resulting in something artificial and tiring.
textos.Várias reviews medianas comentam que a r: Several middling reviews comment that the final twist is easy to predict or that the script gives away clues that are too obvious, making the ending anticlimactic; others criticize the need for long explanations to justify everything.

textos.As reviews medianas mencionam que o film: Middling reviews mention that the film is long and has drawn-out moments, especially in the second half, with scenes that could be shorter.
textos.Algumas pessoas dizem que a estrutura fr: Some people say that the fragmented structure and the back-and-forth in time make it hard to understand at first, although others find that it holds their attention.
textos.Certos comentários sugerem que o filme s: Certain comments suggest that the film underestimates the viewer's intelligence by explaining the plot and the tricks too much, instead of letting the audience figure things out.

textos.As atuações, especialmente as de Christi: The performances, especially those of Christian Bale and Hugh Jackman, are widely praised for their intensity and on-screen chemistry.

textos.Dirigido por Christopher Nolan e lançado: Directed by Christopher Nolan and released in 2006, The Prestige is a drama, mystery and science fiction film set in nineteenth-century London. The narrative follows two illusionists whose friendship turns into a fierce contest for supremacy over the years, resulting in an obsessive rivalry marked by tragic consequences.
textos.A experiência do longa-metragem se apoia: The feature's experience rests on a structure that develops the growing rivalry between the magicians, combining editing geared toward planting clues throughout the plot with a calculated cadence that sets the tone of the narrative.
textos.Os diferentes grupos concentram-se nos m: The different groups focus on the same aspects of the work and disagree on the verdict on how well it works. In the vast majority of ratings (~91%), most extol the construction of the twists and the use of foreshadowing in the story, about half highlight the dramatic weight of the obsession and rivalry between the protagonists and a significant share praise the intensity of the cast's performances. In contrast, from the perspective of those in a tiny fraction of ratings (~7%), many consider the twists predictable and the explanations excessive, a portion judge the female characters as underdeveloped and some point to reservations about the rivalry dynamic. Finally, from the vantage of an even smaller fraction of ratings (~1%), a good portion reject the script as confusing and overly explanatory, several criticize the lack of depth of the female figures and a smaller slice complain of a slow, boring pace.
